description: This file implements the CasimirController class, which manages RF communication with a device via sockets, including connection setup, sending commands, and reading responses. It includes methods for NFC operations, APDU transmission, and broadcast messaging, and interacts with external hardware through socket communication.

classes.name: CasimirController
classes.description: A class that manages RF communication with a device, providing methods for connection, NFC operations, APDU exchange, and broadcasting messages.

methods.name: Mute
methods.description: Turns off the RF field by sending a command.

methods.name: Unmute
methods.description: Turns on the RF field by sending a command.

methods.name: SetPowerLevel
methods.description: Sets the power level for RF operations.

methods.name: ConnectToTcpPort
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a TCP port for RF communication.

methods.name: ConnectToUnixSocket
methods.description: Establishes a connection via a Unix domain socket for RF communication.

methods.name: SelectNfcA
methods.description: Performs NFC-A polling to detect NFC tags.

methods.name: SelectT4AT
methods.description: Selects a T4AT target with a given sender ID.

methods.name: Poll
methods.description: Performs NFC polling to detect a tag and retrieve its sender ID.

methods.name: SendApdu
methods.description: Sends an APDU command to a specified receiver and returns the response data.

methods.name: SendBroadcast
methods.description: Broadcasts data over NFC with specified parameters such as type, CRC, bitrate, and power.
